payload.core_mechanism_summary: Greedy sign assignment: fix last two signs, then process remaining characters in descending order of power-of-two values, greedily subtracting/adding to reduce absolute target to zero.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a greedy exchange argument: after fixing the signs of the last two letters, it iterates from largest to smallest power, making the optimal local choice to decrease |t| by using available copies.
